title: Apps are dead deep-dive
ev: 1971: UNIX V1 terminal - "Type a command" (login: sam, cat todo.txt)
1984: Mac-style windowed GUI - "Point and click"
2007: iPhone - "Tap a screen"
2026: black screen, Jarvis orb - USER: "Hey Jarvis."
Orb opens a circular portal onto the desktop
Cards fly out of the orb (2026 - "Just ask")
Text: "The next interface is not an app."
JARVIS: "Let us set you up."
JARVIS: "Which tools do you use?"
USER: "Gmail, Slack, HubSpot and Stripe." - a Connect card pops in for each one
USER: "Connect them."
JARVIS: "Connected." - icons dock into the Jarvis pill (CONNECTED row)
JARVIS: "Three things need you today." - skeleton, then TO-DO card fills
Rows: Tomas wants 15 percent off renewal / 2pm clashes with board prep / Invoice Lumen Health
USER: "Handle all three."
MORPH: to-do card splits into 3 working cards (Gmail reply, Calendar, Stripe invoice)
Agents panel: 3 tasks; calendar conflict resolved (weekly sync moved)
Stripe invoice ready: Lumen Health $12,400
JARVIS: "One catch: Tomas wants 15 percent off." - Gmail reply card in CHECK
JARVIS: "Your price sheet says 10." - Notion Pricing 2026 cited
USER: "Offer 12, make it warmer, and send both." - draft rewrites
Cards send and collapse into the agents panel
JARVIS: "Done. I will be here." - desktop clears
End card: "No app. No keyboard. Just Jarvis."
